cond_0001.intro:
The mission of the Performance & Data Analytics Engineer is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert/lead regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and provide the Company with a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role will develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will assist internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills
Preferred Requirements
Deep technical understanding of Telecom networks and end to end system performance requirements
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0122.intro:
We are looking for a RAN Performance & Data Analytics Engineer to join our team. The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert/lead regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and provide the Company with a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role will develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will assist internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges. Most people become stronger in this kind of performance and data analytics work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0122.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.

Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.

cond_0142.intro:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer serves as [Company name masked]'s expert regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization, with deep knowledge of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role develops an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role is supported by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality to assist with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role requires familiarity with performance studies across various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0142.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs and KCIs to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPIs have been met or identify trends and issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings.
KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput.
KPI Reports – Contribute to the development and compilation of reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network.
RAN Planning – Coordinate with the Design Engineering Team on RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings.
Data Collection and Testing – Contribute to authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services.
Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers on performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0142.requirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills
Deep technical understanding of Telecom networks and end to end system performance requirements
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time

cond_0152.intro:
We are looking for a RAN Performance & Data Analytics Engineer to join our team.
The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert and lead for Performance Engineering & Network Optimization, bringing a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). You will define and build an overall Performance Program, including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role draws on experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking, and core functionality to drive troubleshooting and optimization efforts with internal and external teams. You will be well versed in performance studies across various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues, and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0152.responsibilities:
You will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and deliver optimal performance.
Responsibilities include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPIs have been met or identify trends and issues that require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings.
KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify and resolve performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput.
KPI Reports – Lead the development and compilation of reports for internal and external stakeholders and build an accessible web interface that allows customers to view and query the performance of their network.
RAN Planning – Direct collaboration with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings.
Data Collection and Testing – Lead the authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services.
Troubleshooting – Deliver escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes, or other optimization measures.
cond_0152.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent
7+ Years of technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Deep technical understanding of telecom networks and end-to-end system performance requirements
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time
Preferred Requirements
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills

The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and to help build a shared understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). Working with internal teams, the role will help develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will support internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0162.responsibilities:
Working alongside cross-functional teams, the Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Work with the team to define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings.
KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends together with relevant stakeholders to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput.
KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation of reports for internal and external stakeholders and help develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network.
RAN Planning – Coordinate with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Help establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings.
Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring proper testing methods and tools for data collection services.
Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support alongside the [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0162.requirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills
Deep Technical understanding of Telecom networks and end to end system performance requirements
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time
cond_0162.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0162.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0266.intro:
We are looking for a RAN Performance & Data Analytics Engineer to join our team. The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert/lead regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and provide the Company with a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role will develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will assist internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges. Most people become stronger in this kind of performance and data analytics work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0266.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.

A Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics

The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0318.requirements:
A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 7 years of technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong analytical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work through complex problems methodically.
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time.
cond_0318.encouragement_text: Working knowledge of Telecom networks and end-to-end system performance requirements; candidates with a solid background in this area and a willingness to deepen that knowledge are encouraged to apply.
cond_0318.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.
cond_0318.workplace_support: We foster connection and community through employee groups and inclusive workplace initiatives so people can bring their full selves to work and find support across different identities and life experiences.

cond_0329.intro:
We are looking for a RAN Performance & Data Analytics Engineer to join our team. The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert/lead regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and provide the Company with a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role will develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will assist internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with RAN performance analysis and network optimization.
cond_0329.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0329.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills
Deep technical understanding of Telecom networks and end to end system performance requirements

The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer serves as [Company name masked]'s expert regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization, with deep knowledge of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role develops an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role is supported by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality to assist with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role requires familiarity with performance studies across various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0412.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs and KCIs to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPIs have been met or identify trends and issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings.
KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput.
KPI Reports – Contribute to the development and compilation of reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network.
RAN Planning – Coordinate with the Design Engineering Team on RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings.
Data Collection and Testing – Contribute to authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services.
Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers on performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0412.requirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills
Deep technical understanding of Telecom networks and end to end system performance requirements
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time

cond_0518.intro:
We are looking for a RAN Performance & Data Analytics Engineer to join our team. The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert/lead regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and provide the Company with a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role will develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will assist internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges. Most people become stronger in this kind of performance and data analytics work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0518.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.

The mission of this role is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and to help build a shared understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). Working with internal teams, the role will help develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will support internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0594.responsibilities:
Working alongside cross-functional teams, the Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Work with the team to define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings.
KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends together with relevant stakeholders to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput.
KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation of reports for internal and external stakeholders and help develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network.
RAN Planning – Coordinate with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Help establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings.
Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring proper testing methods and tools for data collection services.
Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support alongside the [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0594.requirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
7+ Years technical experience in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics
Expert analytical troubleshooting skills
Deep Technical understanding of Telecom networks and end to end system performance requirements
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time

The mission of the Performance & Data Analytics Engineer is to serve as [Company name masked]'s expert/lead regarding Performance Engineering & Network Optimization and provide the Company with a deep understanding of Radio Access Network (RAN) Performance Metrics (PM), the individual counters that make up formulas for Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and Key Capacity Indicators (KCI). The role will develop an overall Performance Program including identification of automation tool requirements, additional counter requirements, [Company name masked] standards, and operating processes for the newly formed function.
This role will be enhanced by experience in RF design, walk test data analysis, IP networking and core functionality that will assist internal and external teams with troubleshooting and optimization efforts. The role will be well versed in performance studies of various environments such as indoor, outdoor, high-capacity venues and labs in the FR1 and FR2 ranges.
cond_0641.responsibilities:
The Performance & Data Analytics Engineer will review and analyze 4G and 5G performance metrics and individual counters that make up formulas for KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and KCIs (Key Capacity Indicators) to assess the health of RAN systems and achieve optimal performance.
Responsibilities will include:
Institute Performance Data – Define performance data (performance measurements and KPIs) to ensure contractual KPI's have been met or identify trends/issues that may require corrective action, such as adjusting physical installation or parameter settings. KPI Analysis – Periodically analyze Key Performance Indicator (KPI) trends to identify performance-related issues, such as drops, mobility problems, attachment issues, or throughput. KPI Reports – Collaborate in the development and compilation reports for internal and external stakeholders and develop an accessible web interface to allow customers to view and query the performance of their network. RAN Planning – Work together with the Design Engineering Team during RAN planning efforts. Establish best practices and recommended configurations for RAN configuration items including, but not limited to, PCI assignment, PRACH configuration, mobility configuration, and cell selection settings. Data Collection and Testing – Collaborate in authoring of proper testing methods and tools for data collection services. Troubleshooting – Provide escalated support to [Company name masked] Technical Support Center or customers troubleshooting performance issues, which may include parameter adjustments, RF design changes or other optimization measures.
cond_0641.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
7+ Years of demonstrated expertise in the telecom industry, specifically in Network Performance and Data Analytics.
Exceptional analytical troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of resolving complex performance issues.
Advanced knowledge of telecom networks and end-to-end system performance requirements.
Ability to travel up to 35% of the time.
